rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound with aṣṭa, qualifying cakraṃ

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth chakra?
premises: The sixth chakra is identified as royal.
This chakra is described as having eight petals.
This chakra is described as possessing a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth chakra is a royal center distinguished by eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: The epithet rājānam may indicate a specific name or a general quality of supremacy.
items.plain_english: But the sixth chakra is the royal one, with eight petals and a pericarp.
